comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Well, I only know a little bit about pets, so it might be better to get information from someone else. But from what I hear, Pet Plunder skill doesn't work in dungeons, and it only has a chance to acquire goods normally found with area search on land or sea in that region -- you know, pet only things like Pardons in the Central Nile, or those MA pet items which cannot be gotten any other way but with pets. Somebody feel free to correct me on that, though...
